method: Genetic self-play initialized from frozen Hard; decision parameters, tactics and whole-game residual weights evolve from match outcomes only.
fitness: Mean win/loss (+1/-1; draw 0), plus 0.01 times score differential clipped to [-20,20]; no action or mechanic rewards.
limitations: The policy refines Hard's existing controller; it is not an end-to-end policy learned from scratch.
Performance is measured against these bot opponents and does not guarantee a win against every human strategy.
Fast matches synchronize the native core, physics, timers, tweens and animation clock at 0.025 seconds.
Idealized frame cadence and visual RNG mean exact seeded outcomes can differ from native rendering; speed-1 confirmation is required.
The Extreme comparison and small native cohort are observed regression/transfer guards, not standalone noninferiority or significance proofs.
